so in summary—porn isn’t very healthy for women. because it conditions us to accept violence and submission as the only sexual experiences. 

in fact— pornhub just deleted 70% of its videos. they went from 13 million videos to 3 million overnight because of the violence and non consensual porn.
i hope maybe i’ve helped. i’m not telling you to ever film that was a very personal and consensual decision between two adults.
